description: Implementation of the DisplayVkWin32 class for Vulkan on Win32, managing window creation, surface setup, and configuration support for Vulkan rendering on Windows.

classes.name: DisplayVkWin32
classes.description: Class implementing Vulkan display functionality for Win32, including window management and surface creation.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Handles cleanup of window resources and unregisters window class.

methods.name: isValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Checks if a given window handle is a valid window.

methods.name: createWindowSurfaceVk
methods.description: Creates a Vulkan window surface for the specified window.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Vulkan display, creates dummy window, registers window class, and sets up Vulkan surface.

methods.name: generateConfigs
methods.description: Generates supported EGL configurations based on color formats.

methods.name: checkConfigSupport
methods.description: Checks if a given EGL config is supported based on surface formats.

methods.name: getWSIExtension
methods.description: Returns the Vulkan Window System Integration extension name.
